pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

3. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. goed
   D. going

5. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

7. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

8. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

10. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.

11. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — One main idea with supporting sentences

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

4. A — went

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

6. C — A person, place, thing, or idea

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

9. B — run

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

12. D — Where is the library?

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Phonics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Word Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
